content: संक्रमणम् .²1 Concurrence. .²2 Transition, progress, passing from one point to another. .²3 Passage. .²4 The sunʼs passage from one zodiacal sign to another. .²5 The day on which the summer solstice begins. .²6 Decease, death; यदि दुःखमकृत्वा तु मम संक्रमणं भवेत् <ls>Rām. 2. 13. 12</ls>. .{@-का@} A gallery; <ls>Buddh.</ls>
